title: Why the bread did not rise
checked: Every reachable state checked (3 states, 7 with their data, 7 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 3 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
Each check takes one bone. There are six to check.

rules.rule: A cause only after every bone
rules.says: The bread is explained only once all six bones are ruled in or out.
rules.path: Take away the all six checked guard and it breaks in 1 step: check next bone.

rules.says: When the bread is explained, exactly one bone is ruled in: the hot water.
